summary: Snowmobiler suffered a medical emergency on Rabbit Ears Pass near Walton Peak. RCSAR diverted from a weekly field training to assist Jackson County SAR; with Classic Air Medical unavailable due to other calls, JCSAR enlisted Flight for Life Colorado. RCSAR members arrived as the Flight for Life helicopter was landing and assisted with readying the patient for transport and loading into the helicopter.
location: Rabbit Ears Pass, near Walton Peak
responding_agency: Jackson County Search and Rescue; Routt County Search and Rescue (assist); Flight for Life Colorado
